en.title: Press Kit
paragraphs: Wayne Matthews is a singer-songwriter based in Belgium. He got his start in 2019 after appearing on Belgium's Got Talent, an experience that pushed him to release his debut EP the same year and pursue music seriously.

His breakthrough came with the 2023 single "Lonely," which picked up national airplay on Radio 2 — his first real signal that the songs he was writing in his own time could reach past a local audience. He followed it with "never meant to lose you" later that year, then "that evening's evil" in 2024, building a small but steady catalogue of singles.

2025 was his busiest year to date: "don't tell me" in May, followed by five more singles through the rest of the year, including "when i no longer need you," "know this isn't your fault," "have a good life," "selfish," and "the first to die alone." He's continued that pace into 2026 with "waiting for you to call," "anythingeverything," and "why can't i save myself."

Live, Wayne has opened for Joker Out — Slovenia's 2023 Eurovision entry — at Trix in Borgerhout, and performed at Kavka Oudaan. His music sits in the alternative singer-songwriter space, leaning acoustic but not stripped-down, with lyrics drawn from ordinary day-to-day experience rather than abstraction.
He continues to write and release independently, with new music planned throughout 2026.

nl.title: Perskit
paragraphs: Wayne Matthews is een Belgische singer-songwriter. Zijn muzikale start begon in 2019 na zijn deelname aan Belgium's Got Talent, een ervaring die hem aanzette om nog datzelfde jaar zijn debuut-EP uit te brengen en serieus werk te maken van muziek.

Zijn doorbraak kwam met de single "Lonely" in 2023, die nationale airplay kreeg op Radio 2 — het eerste echte signaal dat de nummers die hij op zijn eigen tempo schreef ook een publiek buiten zijn directe omgeving konden bereiken. Daarna volgden "never meant to lose you" later dat jaar en "that evening's evil" in 2024, waarmee hij een kleine maar gestage catalogus singles opbouwde.

2025 was tot nu toe zijn drukste jaar: "don't tell me" in mei, gevolgd door nog vijf singles doorheen de rest van het jaar, waaronder "when i no longer need you," "know this isn't your fault," "have a good life," "selfish" en "the first to die alone." Dat tempo zette hij door in 2026 met "waiting for you to call," "anythingeverything" en "why can't i save myself."

Live stond Wayne als opener voor Joker Out — de Sloveense inzending voor het Eurovisiesongfestival 2023 — in Trix Borgerhout, en trad hij op tijdens Kavka Oudaan. Zijn muziek bevindt zich in de alternatieve singer-songwriter hoek, akoestisch van basis maar niet minimalistisch, met teksten die vertrekken vanuit alledaagse ervaringen in plaats van abstractie.
Hij blijft onafhankelijk schrijven en uitbrengen, met nieuwe muziek gepland doorheen 2026.
